title: Lumen
tagline: Take white light apart and put it back where it belongs.
description: Eighteen puzzles about light. Bend a beam with mirrors, cut it in two with a splitter, and break it into red, green and blue with a prism — then land exactly the right colour on every receptor. Colours add where they meet, so yellow is red and green arriving together. Every level has been proved solvable, and the game remembers which ones you have cleared and in how many pieces.
author: HexCave
controls: Click the tray, then click the grid
Right-click to pick a piece back up
howToPlay: Place mirrors, splitters and prisms to route the beam.
A prism splits white into red, green and blue; colours add where they land.
Eighteen puzzles, every one proved solvable.
goal: Light every receptor with exactly the colour it is asking for. All eighteen puzzles have been proved solvable.

1.1.0.notes: In-game coaching: short hints that appear where they are relevant and retire once you have got it.
